title: Transversely Kähler almost contact metric Lie algebras
summary: We study transversely Kähler almost contact metric Lie algebras $(\mathfrak{g},\varphi,ξ,η,g)$ such that the structure $1$-form $η$ is a contact form. They include both quasi Sasakian and anti-quasi-Sasakian Lie algebras of maximal rank. In the case where the center of the Lie algebra is nontrivial, they are $1$-dimensional central extensions of Kähler Lie algebras via a symplectic form. We investigate the $5$-dimensional case, obtaining a classification of $η$-Einstein transversely Kähler almost contact metric Lie algebras of maximal rank.
